headline.title: Making sense of the debate over AI psychosis
headline.summary: In the latest episode of Equity, the discussion centers on the notion that tech CEOs may be particularly susceptible to "AI psychosis." The debate examines the implications of this phenomenon within the context of the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

articles.title: I went looking for the AI weed vape that gives you Bitcoin for smoking
articles.summary: The article explores the Gudtrip, a cannabis vape that claims to reward users with Bitcoin for each hit. The author investigates the device's legitimacy and the implications of combining cryptocurrency with cannabis consumption.

articles.title: How Turkey Hacked the Hair Transplant Industry
articles.summary: Turkey's hair transplant industry has evolved into a billion-dollar sector through the integration of specialized motors and machine learning algorithms. This ongoing innovation has positioned the country as a leading destination for hair restoration services.

articles.title: SoftBank says it will invest up to €75 billion to build French data centers
articles.summary: SoftBank announced plans to invest up to €75 billion in building data centers in France, aiming to develop and operate an additional 5 gigawatts of capacity. This investment is part of the company's strategy to expand its presence in the European data center market.

articles.title: I put Google’s 24/7 AI assistant Gemini Spark to work, and it’s actually pretty useful
articles.summary: Google's Gemini Spark is a 24/7 AI assistant designed to automate everyday tasks such as inbox summaries and local event planning. However, the rationale behind Google creating it as a separate product remains unclear.

articles.title: ‘What a joke’: Github Copilot’s new token-based billing spurs consternation among devs
articles.summary: GitHub Copilot has introduced a new token-based billing system, leading to frustration among developers who are expressing their concerns about the changes. This shift marks a significant transition for the service, which has been widely used in the development community.

articles.title: As the browser wars heat up, here are the hottest alternatives to Chrome and Safari in 2026
articles.summary: The article provides an overview of several alternative web browsers in 2026 that are positioning themselves as competitors to Chrome and Safari. It highlights the features and advantages of these browsers in the context of the ongoing browser wars.

articles.title: How one founder’s bet on ‘the old school web’ is paying off
articles.summary: Craig Campbell, a former Meta engineer, has opted to focus on building a traditional website instead of pursuing opportunities in the AI sector, despite the influx of investment in that area. His decision reflects a strategic bet on "the old school web," which is proving to be successful for his new venture.

articles.title: Meta is reportedly developing an AI pendant
articles.summary: Meta is reportedly working on an AI pendant, expanding its focus on AI-powered hardware. This development indicates the company's commitment to integrating artificial intelligence into wearable technology.

articles.title: Do You Actually Need to Pay for Transcription Software?
articles.summary: The article evaluates the effectiveness of Wispr Flow and other AI-powered transcription software, comparing paid options to free services. It concludes that while paid software may offer enhanced features, many users can achieve satisfactory results with free alternatives.

articles.title: AI grifters are creating fake Black people to sell Shein junk
articles.summary: The article discusses the rise of AI-generated personas, specifically fake Black individuals, used to promote and sell products on platforms like TikTok, highlighting the challenges faced by real Black creators in gaining visibility. It features a case study of a light-skinned Black woman struggling to sell her handmade items while expressing frustrations about audience engagement.

articles.title: The SpaceX IPO is great for Elon Musk and terrible for you
articles.summary: Elon Musk has filed to take SpaceX public, raising concerns about the potential risks for investors, similar to the controversial WeWork IPO. Critics argue that the financial structure and implications of the SpaceX IPO could leave everyday investors at a disadvantage.
